verdict.rationale: Stable is a SaaS virtual mailbox and registered agent service, and such a product could publish its source, so the openness axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an open-source license, a public repository, or source availability. The docs and probes cover only the hosted API, webhooks, llms.txt, and a missing OpenAPI spec, none of which are source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
